body: 把星星emoji ⭐ 做成贴在竖版卡片上的高细节金属徽章，镜面铬，圆润3D五角星，柔和反射、干净阴影。奶油色卡片顶部有欧孔，上部准确标题“STAR CLUB”，底部短标语“Small shine. Big joy.”。3:4产品摄影，单枚徽章。

## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

A single rounded chrome star and both exact English lines are clear. The generated hanging hole is round rather than a euro-slot; this limitation remains visible.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 53. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
